def fitness(self, width, height):
        """
        In guillotine algorithm case, returns the min of the fitness of all 
        free sections, for the given dimension, both normal and rotated
        (if rotation enabled.)
        """
        min_fitness = None
        for section in self.free_sections:
            fitness = section.fitness(width, height)
            if min_fitness is None or fitness < min_fitness:
                min_fitness = fitness
        return min_fitness
